messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up — kicked off a quick speculative-decoding bring-up for llama4o-13b-q4_k on the dev dedicated pool. exp_id=sdc-strata-2026-04-12-01. Posting rough numbers + notes as they come in.

raj: Nice. Are we running with the same beam/sampling config as the baseline? :thinking_face:

zoe: No, using our usual spec config: `speculative=on, speculative_budget=20, fallback_threshold=0.6`. Baseline for comparison is fp16 greedy and fp16 sampling runs.

claire: Paste of first pass metrics (small conv eval subset, 2k prompts):
```
baseline(fp16-greedy): p50=12.4ms p95=48.9ms tokens/s=680 quality(qa_acc)=0.782
speculative(q4_k): p50=6.1ms p95=31.2ms tokens/s=1320 quality(qa_acc)=0.768 (-1.8% abs)
notes: latency halved, tail improved but quality drop non-trivial on QA subset
```

jordan: Where is the drop concentrated? long-context? open-domain?

claire: Mostly in open-domain QA and some multi-turn instruction-following. Short factoid prompts look OK. We see more hallucinations on prompts with long context switches.

raj: Any sign this is quant-specific or speculative-specific? Have we run speculative on fp16 as control?

zoe: Ran a control: speculative on fp16 (no quant) gave p50=5.9ms p95=29.8ms and qa_acc=0.780 (only -0.2% vs baseline). So majority of regression seems to be quant + speculative interaction.

claire: Quick hypothesis: the KV-cache warm path in q4_k slightly perturbs logits under speculative rollout when partial KV snapshots are used. Leads to different top-k trajectories that speculative commit.

raj: Can you paste a minimal example where outputs diverge? plz include steps to repro.

claire: Repro snippet + deterministic seeds: 
```
# repro for divergent trace
python reproduce.py --model llama4o-13b-q4_k --seed 42 --decode speculative --budget 20 --prompt-file sample_diverge.txt
# then compare with
python reproduce.py --model llama4o-13b-q4_k --seed 42 --decode greedy
```

claire: Example prompt (shortened): "Given the timeline of X, what are the immediate implications for Y?"

claire: Greedy answer: "The immediate implication is A, because ..."
claire: Speculative run: "The immediate implication is B, focusing on Z ..."

jordan: Hmm. Do we have log-probs for the partial speculative tokens? If the speculative branch has slightly higher local prob but leads to lower eventual sequence prob, that's the usual tradeoff.

zoe: We captured the trace. Attaching inline log excerpt below: 
```
# token, greedy_logp, spec_logp, greedy_prefix, spec_prefix
"The", -0.2, -0.19, "The immediate implication", "The immediate implication"
"immediate", -0.4, -0.38, "...", "..."
"implication", -1.1, -0.9, "...", "..."
"is", -0.05, -0.02, "...", "..."
"A", -2.9, -2.5, "...A...", "...B..."
```
(Truncated)

raj: Looks like spec path prefers a different token at the branching point with slightly higher local logp in q4_k; cumulative effect pushes to a different sub-tree. That could explain hallucination mode.

claire: Also ran toxicity & bias checks quickly — speculative+quant increases toxicity score by +0.9 percentile and a demographic bias metric by +3.2% relative to baseline. Not huge but concerning for onboarding.

zoe: CI-bot: canary job queued: sdc-strata-01 -> canary-run-17.

ci-bot: canary job sdc-strata-01 started on pool dev-dedicated-3 (job id 7842). Logs streaming to https://ci.internal/jobs/7842

jordan: Action items I propose: 1) run deterministic trace diffs across 10 seeds to measure divergence freq; 2) angle on KV-cache handling in q4_k path (maybe floating rounding); 3) run spec on fp16+lower-budget to map quality/latency curve; 4) add targeted eval for hallucination-sensitive prompts.

raj: +1. Also add an experiment where speculative only triggers after 3 tokens (delayed speculative start) to see if early branching is the culprit.

zoe: I'll queue these: experiments sdc-strata-01a (10 seeds divergence), 01b (delayed-spec start=3), 01c (fp16 control), 01d (kv-const-fix probe). ETA ~4 hours for first batch.

claire: Logging small run from 01a (3/10 seeds diverged into different answer class). Means non-negligible.

raj: If divergence rate > 20% we should block onboarding for q4_k with default spec config. We can offer safe defaults: reduced budget or delayed spec.

zoe: Agreed. For now setting default onboarding flag "speculative": false for q4_k until we have mitigation. Will add opt-in note in model catalog.

jordan: One more thought — let's run a small human eval A/B on top 100 divergence cases to judge perceived correctness. Autometrics might understate semantic regressions.

zoe: Will coordinate with ops and resourcing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

dev-bot: note: created ticket ML-OPTS-321 "Speculative + q4_k divergence investigation" assigned to eng-ml.

zoe: Filing quick summary in the model onboarding doc after the runs finish. Will ping channel with final verdict. :eyes:
